title: Stocks
description: The Stocks tab — the home after login: indices, holdings, products, movers, watchlists, ideas.

screens.name: Home
screens.note: The Stocks home in the user status picked in the prototype settings (User status: US Stocks activation — Lemonn KYC pending → … → Activated —, USD wallet, US holdings — the same settings the US stock page and the wallet follow). Picking a status shows its US tab. Each state is also a screen of its own (hidden in the list), which the activation and add-money taps go to.

screens.name: Home · US Stocks tab
screens.note: The US Stocks tab for a user who has not activated US Stocks: US indices, the Activate US Stocks card (→ risk disclosure sheet, stocks-12), shortcuts, Top Movers (a swipeable row of cards), Brands, Heatmap, themes. A US stock opens its page (not activated). Designed in the US Stocks flow (Figma Home · US tab · Activate US Stocks card); here it is the tab on the app\

screens.name: Home · US Stocks tab · scrolled
screens.note: Same tab, scrolled past the tabs: the compact IND / US tabs are pinned under the top bar.

screens.name: Home · US Stocks intro (FTUX) sheet
screens.note: First launch after release: the IND tab with the US Stocks intro (FTUX) sheet — animated flag, five company logos, three benefits. Activate US Stocks → the risk disclosure (stocks-12); ✕ → Home (stocks-01).

screens.name: Home · US tab · risk disclosure sheet
screens.note: The Risk disclosure (For US Stocks) sheet over the US tab. Agree and Continue submits the activation → under review (stocks-13); closing it → the tab (stocks-09).

screens.name: Home · US tab · activation under review
screens.note: US tab, activation under review (honey card, up to 1 working day). In the prototype it moves on to "activated" (stocks-15) by itself after 2 s; the wallet opens the wallet with the review banner.

screens.name: Home · US tab · activation approved sheet
screens.note: The review is approved: the activated US tab with the "US Stocks is active" sheet (success spot). Add Money to US wallet → the $0 USD wallet (us-stocks-20); Later or closing → the activated Home (stocks-15). The under-review Home (stocks-13) moves here by itself after 2 s.

screens.name: Home · US tab · activation failed
screens.note: US tab, activation failed (PAN could not be verified): red card, Retry Activation → the risk disclosure (stocks-12).

screens.name: Home · US tab · activated · add money
screens.note: US tab, activation successful: green card with the unlocked benefits, Add Money to US wallet → the $0 USD wallet (us-stocks-20). The wallet icon goes there too.

screens.name: Home · US tab · money ready
screens.note: Money reached the US wallet: a "Your money is ready" toast above the navbar (times out after 6 s; no card, as in his design); tapping the toast → the activated page (stocks-17). Wallet → the funded USD wallet (us-stocks-59).

screens.name: Home · US tab · activated · holding
screens.note: US tab for an activated user who holds US stocks: no card, the summary shows US holdings ($). A US stock opens its stock page — NVDA (held) with Buy / Sell, others Buy only. Wallet → the funded USD wallet.

screens.name: Home · US tab · under review · Contact Support
screens.note: Activation still under review after a working day: the honey card gains a Contact Support button. Contact Support opens an email to Lemonn support (mail app), no in-app screen. The wallet opens the wallet\

screens.name: Home · US tab · money on the way
screens.note: After paying on the bank page: the honey "Money on the way" card (trade from Thu 8 PM) with what happens next (debited, converted, credited). Track Transfer and the wallet open the wallet\
